title: Stats
notes: Names are the sheet's own spellings, typo included ("Strenght"). Renaming is safe (TICKET-REF-01), so the fix is a User edit rather than a silent correction here.
countsTowardTotal is the six-core-only rule confirmed on Concept 01 — human 60, elf 64, dwarf 60, Raccoon 59, Demon 90, Monolith 1800, Gods 1920.

APT is the sheet's one derived stat: Charactersheet!E9 is IF(ROUND(J21/Calculator!Q2,0) <= 0, 1, ROUND(J21/Calculator!Q2,0)) with Q2 = 30, which is max(1, round(SPEED / const.apt_value)). It needs constants.json loaded alongside.

Abbreviations are ours, not the sheet's — the sheet addresses stats by row position. They share one flat formula namespace with every skill code, so nothing else may use STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA, HP, MANA, SPEED or APT.

stats.name: Strenght
stats.description: Physical power. The sheet spells it "Strenght"; kept as the sheet has it.

stats.name: Health
stats.description: Hit points. A pool: the composed value is the maximum.

stats.name: Mana
stats.description: Spell fuel. A pool: invested and tracked, which is what v1 could not express.

stats.name: Speed
stats.description: Movement, and through APT the action economy as well.

stats.name: APT
stats.description: Attacks Per Turn. Derived from Speed — Charactersheet!E9.
